parsed.reply: Because the sensation is the subject of the sentence, not you. «La nariz» (or whatever is itching) is doing the stinging or itching to you, so it's the grammatical subject acting on the indirect object «me». You're essentially saying "The nose is itching me," which is why the verb agrees with the body part rather than with you.
